subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation
messages:
From: Alice Robinson <alice@acmefin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Training on customer data - opt-out request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the overview of Redwood's runtime and the routing options. A few follow-ups from our side:

- Acme Financial would like to formally opt out of "training-on-customer-data" or any use of our production request/response pairs for Redwood model improvement. This applies to all data from Acme accounts.
- We need confirmation of the process, an official opt-out statement we can keep on file, and whether this opt-out is retroactive to previously logged inputs.
- Please confirm logging controls: are full request/response payloads stored by default? If so, for how long and where (region)? What redaction options do you offer for PII?
- Data residency: our primary workloads remain in us-west-2; confirm logs and any backups remain in the US unless explicitly requested otherwise.
- Finally, procurement asked for an example signed statement we can attach to our security review.

Could you confirm next steps and timelines? We aim to have the opt-out documented by our security sign-off next week.

Thanks,
Alice Robinson
Head of Security Strategy
Acme Financial Services
[Attachment: acme_opt_out_request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Robinson <alice@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Internal folks looped in to handle the security confirmation and the signed statement. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Opt-out: We can enable a "no-training" flag on the Acme tenant which prevents any request/response data from being used in Redwood model training pipelines going forward. This is effective immediately once enabled.
- Retroactivity: By default, data already processed by downstream model training jobs cannot be removed from those historical model artifacts, but we can ensure no future training uses Acme data. If you require retroactive exclusion from future model refreshes, we will mark all historical logs as excluded from any retraining runs going forward.
- Logging: Production request/response traces are stored for 90 days by default in US regions. We can configure shorter retention for your account (e.g., 30 days) and apply PII redaction rules.
- PII controls: We offer configurable redaction rules (pattern-based and schema-based) and a suppression layer that prevents certain fields from even being written to logs. Neha will follow up with specifics and the redaction template.
- Data residency: Your logs and backups will be pinned to us-west-2. We do not replicate logs to EU unless requested.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Neha (security) to confirm exact redaction templates and retention settings we recommend for finance verticals.
2) I will prepare a signed opt-out statement (short PDF) and return it via DocuSign for your countersignature by EOD tomorrow.
3) Once signed, we will flip the tenant-level "no-training" flag and confirm via a follow-up email with timestamps and change logs.

Attachments: I attached a draft training-opt-out statement for quick review.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan@redwood.com]
[Attachment: redwood-training-opt-out-statement-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Robinson <alice@acmefin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out request

Hi Alice — Neha from Security/Privacy here. Following Jordan's note, confirming the technical controls and attaching the signed opt-out statement.

On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 10:22 AM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Internal folks looped in to handle the security confirmation and the signed statement. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.
> 
> - Opt-out: We can enable a "no-training" flag on the Acme tenant which prevents any request/response data from being used in Redwood model training pipelines going forward. This is effective immediately once enabled.

Details we are implementing for Acme:
- Tenant flag: Enabled (effective timestamp: 2027-03-10T09:05:00-07:00). No future training jobs will ingest data from Acme tenant after this timestamp.
- Log retention: Set to 30 days for account "acmefin" (reduced from default 90 days).
- Redaction: Applied server-side PII suppression for fields matching SSN, CC numbers, and user_identifiers. We will also apply a pattern-based email redaction for any free-text fields sent to the models.
- Access logs & audit: Audit trail entry created for the opt-out toggle and stored with our enterprise audit logs (retained per your contract). We will provide the audit export on request.

Attached: signed opt-out statement (redwood-training-opt-out-statement-signed.pdf) and a short FAQ that explains the mechanics. If you need this executed via DocuSign, here's the link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/XX-YY-ZZ

Please reply to confirm receipt and that the above settings meet your requirements. If you want any adjustments (e.g., 7-day retention or different redaction rules), tell us and we'll update the tenant config.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-training-opt-out-statement-signed.pdf (application/pdf)]
